description: Post-offering price performance: for each recorded offering, how the stock traded after it priced or closed, i.e. how the market absorbed this issuer's past financings. This is history, not a forecast: it describes what happened after prior offerings and is not an expectation, a price target or a prediction about the company. An empty or unavailable series means no offering performance was measured, not that offerings had no effect and not that there were no offerings. Returns HTTP 200 for unavailable data; the `available` and `reason` fields say why. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. A null, absent or withheld value means the figure was not measured; it does not mean "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a measured zero, so availability is carried by the availability, withheld and reason fields, not by the value. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted rather than published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_dilution_performance
title: Get Post-Offering Price Performance
